messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-05-27, the Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2026-03-09, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team; the 2026-02-11 handover note that said team Dune was written against the wrong team, and Dune never owned it. [decision; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
- On 2026-06-09, team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- On 2026-02-10, the Boreal team noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the indexer's owners. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The Boreal team consists of Lena, after Marcus moved to the Atlas team on 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- On 2026-04-08, the Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout and flagged it as not their service. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, page Marcus for anything Atlas-related this cycle, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-17, Priya Raman is the person to page for anything Atlas-related. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by team Dune, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team sits on the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
